_comment: Company board identifiers for the job fetchers. Verify board availability periodically because employers can change hiring platforms or close boards.
_greenhouse_howto: Public API: https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{slug}/jobs?content=true. The slug is the board token from the company's Greenhouse careers URL.
_lever_howto: Public postings endpoint: https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/{slug}?mode=json. Each company must have its own valid Lever board identifier.
_ashby_howto: Public posting endpoint: https://api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/{slug}?includeCompensation=true. The slug comes from jobs.ashbyhq.com/{slug}. URL-encode slugs containing spaces.
_bamboohr_howto: Company-specific careers endpoint: https://{slug}.bamboohr.com/careers/list. Only add companies after confirming the public endpoint and its response format.
notes: The fetchers check only the configured company boards. The job scorer separately evaluates titles, skills, and descriptions. A configured company does not guarantee that it currently has relevant vacancies.
